applies_to: proposed fs_v2 (break_hazard_v1 risk-set rows) — neither is implemented
model_status: NON-EXECUTABLE FOR LIVE TRADING AND UNVALIDATED FOR EMPIRICAL PREDICTION
admission_rule: event status_as_of(T) in {VERIFIED_PRIMARY, CORROBORATED_SECONDARY}; claim_type=occurred; valid_time <= T AND known_at <= T (src/geo_intel/pit.py)
missing_policy: no admissible event => indicator 0 is NOT assumed; a deal-interval with no reviewed exposure mapping is NULL (unknown), distinct from reviewed-no-exposure = 0

candidates.name: geo_confirmed_sanctions_link_open
candidates.definition: a CONFIRMED_DEAL_SPECIFIC sanctions_exposure link exists for the deal with event known_at <= T

candidates.name: geo_confirmed_regulatory_link_open
candidates.definition: a CONFIRMED_DEAL_SPECIFIC regulatory_approval_risk link (geopolitically motivated review, e.g. national-security screening) known by T

candidates.name: geo_days_since_last_confirmed_event
candidates.definition: days from the latest admissible CONFIRMED_DEAL_SPECIFIC event valid_time to T; NULL if none

candidates.name: geo_sector_hypothesis_event_count_90d
candidates.definition: count of admissible events in the trailing 90 days with a reviewed SECTOR_HYPOTHESIS link to the deal
candidates.caveat: hypothesis-level; must be evaluated separately from confirmed links

candidates.name: geo_hormuz_or_energy_disruption_active
candidates.definition: an admissible strait_of_hormuz_maritime / energy_supply_interruption / russia_ukraine_energy_infrastructure event within 30 days before T AND a reviewed energy_transport_costs link

explicitly_excluded: any field derived from UNCONFIRMED, ATTRIBUTED_CLAIM, DISPUTED or RETRACTED clusters
continuous price/rate series (already in the FRED market_observations store; would need their own fs version)
